kind: retrospective concept/render feedback; user-selected SciTek geometry preserved

concept.verdict: Usable overall layout/colour study. Rounded wing tips, softened housings, grille glow and extra small under-wing attachments are not recovered geometric evidence.

reference.kind: Actual original PS04.VID frames 0/15/30/45 cropped from existing private comparison; ST30 preview frames 0/15 also inspected

feedback: Legacy, concept and canonical GLB agree on broad swept wings, paired red stripes, raised central body and twin bronze aft throats.
Concept rounds wing tips and inflates shoulder/forebody contours; use original sources for those shapes, not the concept alone.
Canonical GLB has sharper triangular wing tips, smoother continuous central body transitions and a smaller raised grille rather than the more recessed legacy structure.
Actual GLB surface detailing and wear contrast are less developed than the concept. These findings do not supersede the user-selected latest SciTek geometry or authorize an automatic redesign.

A first diagnostic compared raw native mesh bounds against modifier-evaluated GLB and failed at the small bevelled bow needles. Corrected evaluation checks the dependency graph on both sides without relaxing tolerance; fresh renders were rerun.
